calls.reason: The broad bubble collapse this claim depends on hasn't been shown. CB Insights reports record venture funding through Q3 2026, and the only collapse in the packet is China's regional STAR50 selloff.
OpenAI finished its recapitalization in October 2025, inside the two-year window. The debt conversion never happened, so the predicted consequences can't be tested.
The only evidence is one Microsoft quarter of combined cloud and AI capex. Nothing totals generative-AI spending across companies for the 12 months before the post.

The evidence is mixed. Reuters reports a pretraining plateau, but OpenAI's o1 results show large gains through other methods. Together with the hedged 'may have', this doesn't clearly settle whether the technology peaked.

Scientific American and TechCrunch did cover gains from test-time methods. But no capex pullback has been shown, so the predicted order can't be checked, and nothing shows the coverage was 'desperate'.
